title: Business Gold Rewards Card: Adding Authorized Users with Lounge Access
summary: Explains how to add employee authorized users to a Business Gold Rewards Card account (up to 37 cards) and set each user’s spending controls/category restrictions. It also covers that authorized users can access participating lounges under the same entry requirements as the primary cardholder, and their lounge visits count toward the account’s total of 9 complimentary visits. Includes the steps to add users via Account → Card Management → Add Employee Card, including entering legal name and mailing details.
faqs: How many authorized employee cards can I add to my Business Gold Rewards Card account?
Do authorized users get their own card linked to the same account for expense tracking?
Can authorized users access participating lounges, and do they follow the same entry requirements as the primary cardholder?
Do authorized users’ lounge visits count toward the account’s 9 complimentary visits?
What steps do I follow to add an authorized user (employee) to my account?
Can I set spending controls or category restrictions for each authorized user?
keywords: Same entry requirements as primary cardholder
